learning_objective: The learner can identify common prompt attack approaches and apply defensive techniques such as instruction hierarchy and defensive prompt engineering to protect AI applications.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing that because security is an evolving cat-and-mouse game, no effective defenses against prompt attacks exist.
Assuming tool outputs have the highest priority in instruction hierarchy, when they actually have the lowest priority.
Thinking repeating the system prompt twice has no drawbacks, ignoring the increased cost and latency from extra tokens.
